name: Formula Bot
tagline: Formula Bot is an AI tool that generates Excel and Google Sheets formulas from a plain-English description of what you want to calculate. You type something like 'sum all cells in column B where column A says Approved' and Formula Bot produces the correct formula instantly. It also explains existing formulas in plain language, making it invaluable for non-technical spreadsheet users.
